purpose: Teach: 結びつく/オーディション/去り/今季/真意/一読/一概に/トレーナー

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業精神と、現代の経営、結びつく形で、進めろ、お父さんから、よく言ってる。
lines.en: The founding spirit and modern management — I've always told you they need to move forward together. Your grandfather taught me that.
lines.style: Measured and reflective. Speaks from long experience. Slight pause before 'move forward together' — the weight of that integration. Quiet authority, not instructing but sharing what he's learned.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。社員、若手の社内オーディション、毎年、実施しております。
lines.en: Yes. We conduct an internal audition for younger staff members every year.
lines.style: Formal but warm. Clear, structured sentences — the professional speaking to his father. A hint of pride in the systems he's built. Respectful tempo.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期の同志、何人も、世を去り、寂しい思い、することが、増えたよ。
lines.en: Many of the people I started out with are gone now. It gets lonelier as time goes on.
lines.style: Softer, more introspective. Weight settling in the voice. Pauses after 'gone now' and before 'gets lonelier' — he's not rushing this. Acceptance underneath the melancholy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。今季も、創業時の精神を、社員に、伝えてまいります、お父さん。
lines.en: Yes. This year as well, I'll make sure our people understand the spirit we had at the beginning, Father.
lines.style: Steady, formal respect — he's making a promise. 'Make sure' carries quiet determination. Addressing his father directly. Not hesitant, but careful and deliberate.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんが、創業時に、込めた真意、若手にも、しっかり、伝えていけ。
lines.en: Then make sure the true intentions your father put into those early days reach the younger generation. Really reach them.
lines.style: Shift to firmer direction. Less philosophical, more directive. Light emphasis on 'really' — not a suggestion. The elder setting expectation. Measured but clear.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業者の言葉、社内資料に、一読、価値が、ある内容です、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. The founder's words in our company materials — they're worth reading carefully. Truly.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost reverent. Speaking about something precious. 'Worth reading carefully' gets gentle emphasis. The appreciation in his voice is genuine, not performed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 経営の道、一概には、語れない、複雑で、しかも、奥深いものだ、覚えておけ。
lines.en: Remember this: the path of business can't be reduced to simple rules. It's complex. And deeper than most people ever realize.
lines.style: Philosophical weight. Slight slowdown on 'complex' and 'deeper than most people ever realize.' Not lecturing — more like leaving markers for the next generation. Quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さん、人生のトレーナーとして、私を、ここまで、育ててくださいました、感謝です。
lines.en: Yes. Father, you've been a teacher to me in life — you've brought me to where I am. I'm truly grateful.
lines.style: Warm gratitude grounded in sincerity. No performance. He means this. Slight catch after 'brought me to where I am' — emotion present but contained. Dignified closure.
